title: Wall-to-wall bookcase with a radiator cover
summary: Three bays of shelves across a whole wall, cupboards below, and a radiator cover with grille doors in the middle.
intro: A whole wall for books and storage, with a radiator in the middle of it. Three bays of shelves run wall to wall with panelled cupboards underneath. In the middle bay the cupboard front is a radiator cover: two doors with grille panels that let the heat out and open up when the radiator needs bleeding.

cover.alt: MDF bookcase with shelves above, a grille radiator cover and a panelled cupboard below

steps.title: Uprights first
steps.text: The tall uprights went in first, one each side of the radiator, so the middle bay is built around it.

image.alt: First MDF uprights standing in the alcove next to the radiator

steps.title: Cut from a plan
steps.text: Every board was cut from a printed sheet plan on the bench, so nothing gets cut twice.

image.alt: Cutting list and board plan clipped to a board on the bench

steps.title: Round the radiator
steps.text: The middle bay frames the radiator with space all round it, so the heat can rise behind the grille.

image.alt: Frame built round the radiator in the middle bay

steps.title: Laser for the shelves
steps.text: A laser level throws a line across the bays to set the shelf heights.

image.alt: Laser line across the back of a bay

steps.title: Shelves in
steps.text: Shelves in all three bays and the cupboard bases fronted by the end of day two.

image.alt: Shelves fitted in all three bays with cupboards underneath

steps.title: Grille doors on
steps.text: The grille doors went on last, with the panelled cupboard doors either side.

image.alt: Grille doors fitted over the radiator in the middle bay
